summary: Tested (1) the Campuran (mix) rule in Salin Harga & Stok ke Cabang and (2) the fix for Rupiah decreases in Edit Massal Cabang, on backend and UI at 390px. All requested flows work. New test file test_branch_mix.py: 12/12 passed, including applying the mix rule. test_branch_bulk.py (BC_ALLOW_APPLY=1, -n0, run on its own): 26/26 passed. test_branch_copy_pct.py (BC_ALLOW_APPLY=1, -n0, run on its own): 16/16 passed. Mix preview with threshold 20000, +10%, +2000: by_pct 958 and by_rp 5660, which matches the DB count of Sidoarjo prices below 20000. Sample prices match ceil-to-Rp100 integer math. Threshold 0 gives 400 'Isi ambang harga untuk aturan campuran'. Negative pct (-5) in mix works. Mix apply: every non-protected jombang product has the exact expected unit and tier prices, with tiers following their product's choice. Bulk: rp -1000 on Gula Pasir gives 200 (20.500 -> 19.500, tiers -1000). -19000 skips the product with row 0 and reason '... akan jadi 0 / minus. dilewati'. A full-catalog -5000 changed 6603 and skipped 15, and no price, original price or tier is <= 0. pct -91 / -100 give 400 'Persen harus antara -90 dan 100'. UI: the Campuran chip shows threshold/add/pct fields with hints; the preview shows the bc-mix line (jombang only); empty threshold shows the Indonesian error. In the jombang dialog, Turunkan + Rupiah + 1000 shows a preview with no 422; 19000 shows bb-errors with the skipped product and hides Simpan. Real data was backed up and restored exactly after every apply.

minor.issue: `.replace(',', '.')` (meant for the thousands separator) also replaces the comma in the sentence. The reason reads 'akan jadi 0 / minus. dilewati' instead of 'akan jadi 0 / minus, dilewati'. Format only the number. Reference: /app/backend/branch_price.py:204

The reason always quotes the unit price, even when a grosir tier is what would go <= 0. Example: Gula Pasir unit 20.500 at -19000 would become 1.500, but the reseller tier 18.872 would go negative. The message says 'harga 20.500 akan jadi 0 / minus', which confuses the owner. Mention the lowest price, or say 'harga grosir'.

The skip check always includes tier prices, even when tiers=false ('Ubah juga harga grosir' off). Tiers are not changed in that case, so a valid unit-price decrease is skipped. Verified: {mode:rp, value:-19000, q:'Gula Pasir', tiers:false} gives changed 0 with 1 error, although 20.500 -> 1.500 is valid. Reference: /app/backend/branch_price.py:203

issues: Still open from iteration 51: at 390px the tool buttons wrap, leaving 'Unggah Excel' alone on a second row.
In mix mode many cheap products drop below the current branch price (e.g. 7.500 -> 6.100), but there is only a 'big_rise' warning and no warning for price drops. Optional: show a 'turun' count.

action_items: LOW: Fix the skip reason punctuation (format only the number with '.'), and say which price (unit or grosir) would go <= 0.
LOW: In bulk rp preview, include tier prices in the <= 0 check only when body.tiers is true.
OPTIONAL: Show the number of price decreases in the branch-copy preview (mix/negative pct).
critical_code_review_comments: branch_copy.price_fn: the mix rule picks the mode once per product from the Sidoarjo unit price, so tiers stay consistent. Correct.

Rule.price_add allows a negative value (ge=-1_000_000), and mode rp/mix clamps to max(1, v+add). A branch-copy price can therefore become Rp1, with no skip or warning (unlike the new bulk protection). The UI sends only positive add values, so this is API-only.
BulkIn.value now has no schema bound. Per-mode checks give Indonesian 400s for pct outside -90..100, rp beyond ±100M, and 0. Iteration 51's HIGH bug is fixed.
No deprecated Expo packages found in the reviewed files.
